title: Data Analyst
description:
BI Analyst

Up to £45,000 - Oxford

Are you a BI Analyst who enjoys turning data into actionable insights and working closely with stakeholders to solve business challenges?

We are working with an organisation that is continuing to invest in its data and analytics capability and is looking to add a BI Analyst to its growing team. This role will focus on delivering meaningful reporting, analysing business performance, and helping stakeholders make data-driven decisions through high-quality Power BI solutions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a blend of technical development and business engagement. You will work with a variety of stakeholders across the organisation, helping to understand reporting requirements, develop insights, and improve the overall use of data within the business.

If you enjoy working with Power BI, writing complex SQL queries and translating data into clear business value, this could be a great next step in your career.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and visualisations.
  • Gathering requirements from stakeholders and translating business needs into reporting solutions.
  • Writing and optimising SQL queries to extract, manipulate and analyse data.
  • Delivering insights and recommendations to support key business decisions.
  • Monitoring data quality and investigating reporting discrepancies.
  • Creating and maintaining documentation for reports, dashboards and KPI definitions.
  • Working closely with business teams to identify opportunities for improved reporting and analytics.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analysing large datasets.
  • Good commercial experience with Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualisation.
  • Ability to gather and understand business requirements from non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating meaningful reports and presenting insights to the business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Understanding of data modelling and reporting best practices would be advantageous.

What's On Offer?

  • Up to £45,000 salary.
  • Hybrid working model (2 days per week in Oxford).
  • Opportunity to work closely with key business stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a variety of reporting and analytics projects.
  • Supportive team environment with opportunities for career progression.
  • Chance to make a tangible impact through data-driven decision making.

Whether you're an experienced BI Analyst or looking to build on your reporting and analytics expertise, this role offers the opportunity to work with modern BI tools while delivering real business value through data and insight.
